name: Lovecha ~Tsumasakidachi de, Hitomi o Tojite~
original_name: らぶちゃ ～つま先立ちで、瞳をとじて～
source:
The main character, Masashi Kozue, is a teacher who works at a certain school. He lives a fulfilling life surrounded by noisy yet cute students.

That is until, by chance, his students find out that he is actually still a virgin, thus earning him the unfortunate nickname of "Virgin Sensei''.

Teased and mocked about this day after day, Masashi begins to strongly desire to lose his virginity. Gradually, and perhaps unsurprisingly, he starts to see his students in a sexual way.
translation:
主人公梢正志是一所学校的教师，生活被吵闹却可爱的学生包围，过得十分充实。

直到某天，学生们偶然发现他其实还是处男，于是给他取了一个倒霉的绰号：“处男老师”。

正志日复一日地被取笑，开始强烈渴望失去处男之身。渐渐地，也许并不出人意料，他开始以性视角看待自己的学生。
